# Place a coffee order

As a customer, I want to order drinks and pastries for pickup, so that I know my total
before I pay.

## Acceptance criteria

1. An order of 2 Espresso S and 1 Blueberry Muffin L has a total of 900 cents ($9.00).
2. The order keeps the name "Sam" and the pickup time "08:30".
3. The order lists 2 Espresso S at 275 cents each, then 1 Blueberry Muffin L at 350 cents.
